mapper.sql: c.course_id, c.name, c.course_type, c.gu_name, c.distance_km, c.duration_min, c.difficulty, c.features, c.loop_type, c.subway_info, c.start_lat, c.start_lng, c.guide_url, c.source
mapper.select: SELECT , ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(c.start_lng, c.start_lat)) / 1000 AS distance_from_me FROM courses c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.is_active = 1
